sa: प्रयुज्यमानमाज्ञाय दैतेयास्त्रं महाबलम्। ब्रह्मास्त्रेणान्तराच्छित्त्वा मुमोचान्यान् पतत्रिणः।
en: Cutting off those greatly powerful weapon of the Daitya in the mid-air by means of the Brahma weapon, he (Pradyumna) discharged winged weapons of other kinds.

sa: स चिन्तयन्ननेकाग्रः शोकव्याकुलचेतनः। क्षत्तुः सम्प्रेषयामास शीघ्रमागम्यतामिति॥
en: Anxious meditating on everything and with mind deprived of its equanimity by grief, he sent for Khattwa (Vidura) asking him to come (to him) without delay.

sa: अद्भुतस्याद्भुतं पुत्रं प्रवक्ष्याम्यमितौजसम्। जातं ब्रह्मर्षिभार्याभिर्ब्रह्मण्यं कीर्तिवर्धनम्॥
en: I shall (now) speak to you about the wonderful and famous and highly effulgent son of Adbhut, who was born of the wives of the Brahmarsis.

sa: पितामहसरो गत्वा शैलराजसमीपतः। तत्राभिषेकं कुर्वाणो ह्यग्निष्टोममवाप्नुयात्॥
en: And going to the tank, sacred to the Grandsire (Brahma) (situate) near the king of mountains and bathing there, one obtains the fruits of Agnishtoma sacrifice.

sa: तत्रासनेषु विविधेष्वासीनाः पृथिवीक्षितः। सुरभिस्रग्धराः सर्वे प्रमृष्टमणिकुण्डलाः॥
en: There all the rulers of the earth decked in fragrant garlands and adorned with ornaments set with gems suspended from their cars, took their respective seats.

sa: अर्थतत्त्वविधानज्ञः सर्वधर्मविधानवित्। भीमसेनादवरजः फाल्गुनः कुशली दिवि॥
en: Falguni the next by birth to Bhimasena, versed in the science of profit and acquainted with the principles of all duties, is all right in heaven.

sa: कुन्तीमातः कथमिमापापदं त्वमवाप्तवान्। कश्शायं पर्वताभोगप्रतिमः पन्नगोत्तमः॥
en: “O son of Kunti, how have you met with this disaster? And who is this best of serpents endued with a body (huge) as a mountain.

sa: मयूरैश्चातकैश्चापि नित्योत्सवविभूषितम्। व्याप्रैर्वराहैर्महिषैर्गवयैर्हरिणैस्तथा॥
en: And by peacocks and Chatakas, inhabited by tigers, boars, buffaloes, Gabayas and deer,

sa: एतद् विनशनं कुक्षौ मैनाकस्य नरर्षभ। अदितिर्यत्र पुत्रार्थं तदन्नमपचत् पुरा॥
en: O foremost of men, here is the spot where the Mainaka has sunk into the interior of the earth. It is therefore called Vinasana. In order to obtain sons Aditi in the days of yore cooked his famous food.

sa: नहुषो नाम राजर्षिर्व्यक्तं ते श्रोत्रमागतः तवैव पूर्वः पूर्वेषामायोर्वंशधरः सुतः॥
en: It is known (to everybody) that there was a royal sage, named Nahusha and you too, no doubt have heard of him. He was the ancestor of your forefathers, the son of Ayu and the perpetuator of his race.

sa: द्वौ करौ न प्रयच्छेतां कुन्तीपुत्राय भारत। सम्बन्धिकेन पञ्चालाः सख्येनान्धकवृष्णयः॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, only two (race) do not pay tribute to the son of Kunti, the Panchalas on account of their relationship by marriage and the Andhakas and the Vrishnis on account of their friendship (with the Pandavas).

sa: समुद्रकुक्षिमाश्रित्य दुर्गे प्रतिवसन्त्युत। तिस्रः कोट्य: समाख्यातास्तुल्यरूपबलप्रभाः॥
en: Taking refugee in the womb of the ocean, dwell in forts. They are thirty millions in number and are all equal in structure, prowess and splendour.

sa: वनानि देवदारूणां मेघानामिव वागुराः। हरिचन्दनमिश्राणि तुङ्गकालीयकान्यपि॥
en: He also saw forests of Devadaru (pine) trees looking like a net for the clouds and also Tunga and Kaliyaka forests interspersed with yellow sandal trees.

sa: एषामेकैकशो राजन्नय॑मानीयतामिति। अथ चैषां वरिष्ठाय समायोपनीयताम्॥
en: Therefore, O king, bring Arghya for each of them; and let the Arghya be first presented to him who is the foremost of all of them.

sa: विदर्भान् यातुमिच्छामि दमयन्त्याः स्वयंवरम्। एकाला हयतत्त्वज्ञ मन्यसे यदि बाहुक॥
en: "O Bahuka, O you who are well-versed in the knowledge of horses, if you are willing, I desire to go, in course of a day, to the country of the Vidharbhas, where will be held the Svayamvara of Damayanti."

sa: स वार्यमाणस्तैरस्त्रैरर्जुनेन महात्मना। गन्धर्वराजो बलवान् माययान्तर्हितस्तदा॥
en: When the mighty Gandharva king saw that he was checked by the high-souled Arjuna with his weapons, he disappeared from view by the help of illusion.

sa: ततो विदर्भाधियतेर्नियोगाद् ब्राह्मणास्तदा। दमयन्तीमथो सृत्वा प्रस्थिता:स्मेत्यथाब्रुवन्।॥
en: Thereupon, at the injunction of the king of the Vidharbhas, all the Brahmanas approached Damayanti and told her that they were going away (for searching Nala).

sa: जन्तुस्तुकर्मभिस्तैस्तैः स्वकृतैः प्रेत्य दुःखितः। तदुःखप्रतिघातार्थमपुण्यां योनिमाप्नुते॥
en: Animate creatures become miserable in the next world from their own actions and as the result of those miseries they are (again) born as lower animals.

sa: भरतो भरतस्याग्नेः पावकस्तु प्रजापतेः। महानत्यर्थमहितस्तथा भरतसप्तम॥
en: The Bharata Agni was the son of Prajapati Bharata Agni. O best of the Bharata race, because he was greatly honoured, therefore he was called “great".

sa: अन्तरात्मन्यभिहते रौषि पत्ररथाशुचि। अण्डभक्षणकर्मैतत् तव वाचमतीयते॥
en: It is this “O bird, though your heart is affected, yet you preach. But your this sinful act of eating the eggs transgresses of your speeches".

sa: अथवानडुहे राजन् साधवे साधुवाहिने। सौहित्यदानादेतस्मादेनसः प्रतिमुच्यते॥
en: O king, (if you violate the pledge) you may free yourself from its sin by offering good food to a well-conducted bull which carries sacred burdens.

sa: अपि संचयबुद्धिर्हि लोभमोहवशंगतः। उद्वेजयति भूतानि पापेनाशुद्धबुद्धिना॥
en: Some one, overwhelmed by cupidity and stupefaction, becomes bent on storing riches. He is seen to persecute all creatures, urged by a sinful and impure understanding.

sa: किमर्थं तप्यसे देवि तपो घोरमनिन्दिते। प्रीतस्तेऽहं महाभागे तपसानेन शोभने॥
en: O highlyblessed one, I am pleased with your penances, O beautiful one! Do you, O goddess, beg what boon you wish to have. I shall grant you whatever, you may ask! These were my words to her, O Purandara.

sa: उपतस्थुर्यथोद्यन्तमादित्यं मन्त्रकोविदाः। प्रभावात् तपसस्तेषामृषीणां वीक्ष्य पाण्डवाः॥
en: The Pandavas saw that the points of the compass shining on account of the energy of their penances, and became filled with wonder at the spectacle.

sa: त्रयाणामपि लोकानामुपरिष्टान्निवत्स्यसि। मत्प्रसादाच्च विख्यातो गोलोकः सम्भविष्यति॥
en: Your offspring, ever engaged in doing good deeds, will live in the world of men, In fact, O highly blessed one, your daughters will live there.

sa: वार्ष्णेय मधुहन् वीर शिरसा त्वां प्रसादये। द्रोणपुत्रास्त्रनिर्दग्धं जीवयैनं ममात्मजम्॥
en: o you of Vrishni's race, O destroyer of Madhu, I seek to please you by bending my head, O hero to you! Do you revive this child of mine who has been consumed by the weapon of Drona's son.

sa: शरानापततः क्रूरानाशीविषविषोपमान्॥ विच्छेद निशितैर्बाणैरन्तरा स धनंजयः।
en: Dhananjaya, with his own whetted arrows, cut off those arrows of sharp and terrible points, resembling stakes of dreadful poison, before could come up to him.

sa: भीष्म उवाच ऋत्विक् पुरोहिताचार्याः शिष्यसम्बन्धिबान्धवाः। सर्वे पूज्याश्च मान्याश्च श्रुतवन्तोऽनसूयकाः॥
en: Bhishma said If the Ritvij, the Purohita, the preceptor, the Acharya, the disciple, the relative (by marriage), and kinsmen, happen to be endued with learning and free from malice, then should they be considered worthy of respect and adoration.

sa: प्रगृह्यौदुम्बरं पात्रं पक्वान्नं मधुना सहा सोमस्योत्तिष्ठमानस्य पौर्णमास्यां बलिं हरेत्॥
en: Taking a vessel of copper and placing therein some cooked food after having mixed it with honey, one should offer it as offerings to the rising Moon on the evening of the day when that luminary is at full.

sa: वर्णे तृतीये जातस्तु वैश्यायां ब्राह्मणादपि। द्विरंशस्तेन हर्तव्यो ब्राह्मणस्वाद् युधिष्ठिर॥
en: The son who has been born of the wife belonging to the third caste, viz., the woman of the Vaishya caste, by the Brahmana father, shall take, O Yudhishthira, two of the three remaining shares of the father's property.

sa: युधिष्ठिरस्तु नृपतिर्नातिप्रीतमनास्तदा। धारयामास तद् राज्यं निहतज्ञातिबान्धवः॥
en: King Yudhishthira, after the death of his uncle, became very cheerless. Deprived of his kinsmen and relatives, he somehow bore the burthen of sovereignty. JAVASIKA PARVA

sa: स्वर्गद्वारं सुसूक्ष्मं हि नरैर्मोहान्न दृश्यते॥ स्वर्गार्गलं लोभबीजं रामगुप्तं दुरासदम्।
en: The door of Heaven is very difficult to see. Through carelessness men cannot see it. The bar of Heaven's door has cupidity for its seed. That bar is kept fastened by desire and affection. Indeed, Heaven's door is unapproachable.

sa: नासत्यश्चापि दत्तश्च स्मृतौ द्वावश्विनावपि॥ मार्तण्डस्यात्मजावेतौ संज्ञानासाविनिर्गतौ।
en: Nasatya and Dasra are said to be the two Ashvins. They are the sons of Martanda born of his wife Samjna, from whose nostrils they emanated.

sa: प्रकृत्यात्मकमेवाहू रजः पर्यायकारकम्। प्रवृत्तं सर्वभूतेषु दृश्यमुत्पत्तिलक्षणम्॥
en: Darkness is said to have activity for its essence. It is the cause of successive deeds. When it predominates, its mark, among all beings, is production,

sa: देवताश्चानुमन्यन्ते विमलाः सर्वतो दिशः। द्योतते च यथाऽऽदित्यः प्रेतलोकगतो नरः॥
en: The celestials ordain that on very side of such a person there should be burning light. Indeed, when the giver of lights goes to the world of the dead, he himself shines in pure effulgence like a second sun.

sa: देवगन्धर्वसंघातैरप्सरोभिश्च सर्वतः। नृत्तश्चैवोपगीतश्च पितामह इव प्रभुः॥
en: The deities and Gandharvas and Apsaras in large bands began to sing and dance around him even as they sing and dance around the Grandfather Brahman.

sa: नास्तीत्येवं व्यवस्यन्ति सत्यं संशयमेव च॥ तदयुक्तं व्यवस्यन्ति बालाः पण्डितमानिनः।
en: They assert that nothing, however true, exists which is not directly perceivable; or, at least, they doubt the existence of those objects. Such assertions however are absurd and they who make them are fools, whatever their pride of learning.

sa: तस्या वत्समुखोत्सृष्टः फेनो मद्गात्रमागतः। ततो दग्धा मया गावो नानावर्णत्वमागताः॥
en: Once on a time a quantity of froth fell from the mouth of one of her calves on my body. I was enraged at this and my anger scorched all the kine which there upon became diversified in colour.

sa: इत्युक्तोऽहं धर्मराजं द्विजर्षे धर्मात्मानं शिरसाभिप्रणम्य। अनुज्ञातस्तेन वैवस्वतेन प्रत्यागमं भगवत्पादमूलम्॥
en: Thus did the judge of the dead speak to me, O twiceborn Rishi. I then bowed my head to the righteous Yama. Getting his permission I left his kingdom and have now come to the sole of your feet.

sa: अन्यद् दानं तु विप्रर्षे श्रूयतां पावनं महत्। दिव्यमत्यद्भुताकारमपत्यं जातवेदसः॥
en: There is another gift that is considered as a great purifier. Listen to us, O twiceborn Rishi, as we discourse on it! That article is excellent and is wonderful to look at and is, besides, the offspring of Fire

sa: तथा वज्रेण भगवानमर्षाकुललोचनः। तमापतन्तं दृष्ट्वैव च्यवनस्तपसान्वितः॥
en: The king of the deities was also armed with the Thunderbolt. Then the illustrious Chyavana, gifted with penances, cast angry looks upon Indra as he advanced.

sa: परिदेवयती नत्र कौरवानभ्यभाषत॥ निबोधत यथावृत्तमुच्यमानं मयाऽनघाः।
en: In the midst of her lamentations, she addressed the Kurus, saying, You sinless ones, listen to me as I say to you all that took place.

sa: अार्हान् न च सत्कारैरर्चयन्ति यथाविधि। अर्ध्यमाचमनीयं वा न यच्छन्त्यल्पबुद्धयः॥
en: Indeed, they do not honour, according to the ordinance, with gifts of the Arghya, such persons as deserve to be honoured therewith. They do not offer water for washing the mouth to such as deserve to have that honour.

sa: मध्यस्थस्येह विप्रस्य योऽनूचानस्य भारत। वृत्तिं हरति दुर्बुद्धिस्तं विद्याद् ब्रह्मघातिनम्॥
en: You should, O Bharata, know that man as guilty of Brahmanicide who destroys the means of living of a Brahmana well-read in the Vedas, and all their branches and who is shorn of attachments to worldly creatures and goods.

sa: पितृशुश्रूषणे किं च मातृशुश्रूषणे तथा। आचार्यगुरुशुश्रूषास्वनुक्रोशानुकम्पने॥
en: What are the merits of serving the parents. What also are the merits of serving preceptors and teachers, and what the merits of mercy and kindness?

sa: अग्निमित्येव तत् प्राहुः प्रदानं च सुखावहम्। यथेष्टगुणसंवृत्तं प्रवर्तकमिति स्मृतम्॥
en: It has been said that gold is at one with Agni. The gift of gold, therefore, yields great happiness. The gift of gold leads to the possession of those merits and qualities that are desired, and purifies the heart.

sa: बहुधा विप्रबोधिते। निश्चयं नाधिगच्छामः सम्मूढाः सुरसत्तम॥
en: O foremost of the celestials, duty being thus confused and full of contradictions of various kinds, we are deluded and unable to arrive at any conclusion.

sa: अपहत्य तमस्तीवं यथा भात्युदये रविः। तथापहत्य पाप्मानं भाति गङ्गाजलोक्षितः॥
en: Even as the Sun, when he rises at the dawn of day, shines, having removed the darkness of night, likewise the person who has bathed in the waters of Ganga is seen to shine, purged of all his sins.

sa: ज्ञातीनां गृहमध्यस्था सक्तूनत्तु दिनक्षये। अभोग्या वीरसूरस्तु बिसस्तैन्यं करोति या॥
en: Disregarding the kinsmen of her husband, let her live in her husband's house and eat, every evening, the flour of fried barley! Let her come to be considered as unenjoyable. Let her be the mother of a heroic son.

sa: मुजं शरीरमित्याहुरिषीकामात्मनि श्रिताम्। एतन्निदर्शनं प्रोक्तं योगविद्भिरनुत्तमम्॥
en: The body has been called the Saccharum Munja and the filbrons pith is called the Soul. This is the excellent illustration given by persons knowing Yoga.

sa: सर्वमित्रः सर्वसहः शमे रक्तो जितेन्द्रियः। व्यपेतभयमन्युश्च आत्मवान् मुच्यते नरः॥
en: That man who is the friend of all, who endures all, who is attached to tranquillity, who has conquered all his senses, who is shorn of fear and anger, and who is of controlled soul, succeeds in liberating himself.

sa: सान्तःपुरपरीवारः सभृत्यः सपुरोहितः। यथासुखं यथोद्देशं धृतराष्ट्राभ्यनुज्ञया।॥
en: With the royal ladies, the servants, and his priest, the king roved about the hermitage in all directions as he pleased, at the command of Dhritarashtra.

sa: मृगनिर्मोकवसनाश्चीरवल्कलवाससः। निर्द्वन्द्वाः सत्पथं प्राप्ता बालखिल्यास्तपोधनाः॥ अङ्गुष्ठपर्वमात्रा ये भूत्वा स्वे स्वे व्यवस्थिताः। तपश्चरणमीहन्ते तेषां धर्मफलं महत्॥
en: Their dress consists of deerskins or barks of trees. Freed from pairs of opposites, the Valakhilyas, having penances for wealth, walk in this track of virtue. They are as big as a digit of the thumb. Divided into classes, each class lives in the practice of its duties. They wish only to practise penances. The merits they acquire by their righteous conduct are very great.

sa: ऋतुर्मातुः पितुर्बीजं दैवतं परमं पतिः॥ भर्तुः प्रसादान्नारीणां रतिपुत्रफलं तथा।
en: In the production of children the mother contributes her blood. The father contributes his sced. The husband is the highest deity of the wife. Through the favour of the husband, women get both pleasure and offspring as the reward.

sa: पिङ्गाश्च लोहितग्रीव कृष्णवर्त्मन् हुताशन। परेण प्रेहि मुञ्चास्मान् सागरस्य गृहानिव॥
en: O Agni of copper-coloured eyes and of red neck, o deity whose path is marked by black colour, save us as the ocean saves the houses on its banks by going away (from this place) by some other way.

sa: प्रत्यग्रहः कुशाम्बश्च यमाहुर्मणिवाहनम्। मावेल्लश्च यदुश्चैव राजन्यश्चापराजितः॥
en: His other sons were Pratyagraha and Kushamba, who was also called Manivahana. Two others were Mavella and Yadu who was greatly powerful and invincible in battle.

sa: सुतप्रियैषी ताराजा पाण्डवानम्बिकासुतः। ततो विवासयामास राज्यभोगबुभुक्षया॥
en: That king, the of Ambika, (Dhritarashtra), out of affection for his sons and being tempted by the desire for sovereignty, sent them (the Pandavas) to exile.

sa: यायावराणां प्रवरो धर्मज्ञः संशितव्रतः। स कदाचिन्महाभागस्तपोबलसमन्वितः॥
en: He was the foremost of Yayavaras, a man of rigid vows, highly religious and endowed with great ascetic powers. Once upon a time this great ascetic,

sa: गां विन्दता भगवता गोविन्देनामितौजसा। वराहरूपिणा चान्तर्विक्षोभितजलाविलम्॥
en: It was in days of yore disturbed by the greatly powerful Lord Govinda (Vishnu) when he assumed the form, of a boar for raising the earth.

sa: यदाश्रौषं हृतराज्यं युधिष्ठिरं पराजितं सौबलेनाक्षवत्याम्। स्तदा नाशंसे विजयाय संजय॥
en: I had no hope of success, O Sanjaya, when I heard that Yudhishthira had been defeated by Saubala at dice and had been deprived of his kingdom as its result but still he was attended by his powerful brothers.

sa: तस्मात् तजननीहेतोर्मानुषत्वमुपागता। जनयित्वा वसूनष्टौ जिता लोकास्त्वयाक्षयाः॥
en: Therefore, I assumed the human form, to become their mother. You have acquired great regions of celestial bliss by becoming the progenitor of the eight Vasus.

sa: समुद्रसेनस्तु नृपस्तेषामेवाभवद्गणात्। विश्रुतः सागरान्तायां क्षितौ धर्मार्थतत्त्ववित्॥
en: The seventh of the brothers) became king Samudrasena, famous all over the earth from its centre to the sea and he was learned in the Shastras.

sa: पुंसा सह समायोगो न स धर्मोपघातकः॥
en: “O amiable child, the act that you have committed today in secret without having waited (to receive my permission), has not been destructive of your virtue.

sa: अलंकृतं द्वीपवत्या मालिन्या रम्यतीरया। नरनारायणस्थानं गङ्गयेवोपशोभितम्॥
en: The river was studded with many islands with beautiful and charming shores. It looked like the abode of Nara and Narayana, beautified with the river Ganges.

sa: ततः परमदुष्प्रापमन्यैर्ऋषिरुदारधीः। समापिपयिषुः सत्रं तमत्रिः समुपागमत्॥
en: Then the great and the liberal-minded Rishi Atri came to that place with the desire of ending that sacrifice, a highly difficult act for any others.

sa: वह्वेश्चापि प्रदीप्तस्य खमुत्पेतुर्महार्चिषः। जनयामासुरुद्वेगं सुमहान्तं दिवौकसाम्॥
en: The great flame of the blazing fire rose to the sky and created a great anxiety in the minds of the dwellers of heavens the Devas.

sa: कच्चिदार्यो विशुद्धात्मा क्षारितश्चौरकर्मणि। अदृष्टशास्त्रकुशलैर्न लोभाद् वध्यते शुचिः॥ दुष्टो गृहीतस्तत्कारी तज्ज्ञैर्दृष्टः सकारणः। कच्चिन्न मुच्यते स्तेनो द्रव्यलोभान्नरर्षभ॥
en: O best of men, no well-beloved, puresouled and respected person is surely deceived and his life is not taken in a false charge of theft by your ministers, who are ignorant of Shastras and who are covetous? Your ministers do surely never, out of covetousness, allow a real thief to escape, knowing him to be such and after arresting him with the booty on him?

sa: यद्यहं स्तुवतस्तात दुहिता प्रतिगृह्णतः। प्रसादयिष्ये शर्मिष्ठामित्युक्ता तु सखी मया॥
en: O father, if I am really the daughter of a hired chanter of others' praises and of one who accepts alms, I must adore her in the hope of getting her favour. I have already told this to her.

sa: कूर्मोऽष्यभ्युद्यतशिरा युद्धायाभ्येति वीर्यवान्। षडुच्छ्रितो योजनानि गजस्तद्द्विगुणायतः॥
en: The greatly powerful tortoise also, with its head up, comes to the fight. The elephant is six Yojanas in height and twice that measure in circumference.

sa: यस्तु स्यात् कामवृत्तोऽपि पार्थ ब्रह्मपुरस्कृतः। जयेन्नक्तंचरान् सर्वान् स पुरोहितधूर्गतः॥
en: O Partha, a Kshatriya, engaged in the exercise of his desire, may defeat all the wanderers of night (as we are), if he is sanctified by Brahma and if he assigns the cares of his state to his priest.

sa: यो मे पुत्रात् प्रियतरः सर्वशस्त्रविशारदः। ऐन्द्रिरिन्द्रानुजसमः स पार्थो दृश्यतामिति॥
en: “Behold all of you now that Partha who is dearer to me then my own son, who is the master of all arms, who is the son of Indra himself and who is like the younger brother of Indra."

sa: यायावरकुले धीमान्भविष्यति महानृषिः। जरत्कारुरिति ख्यातस्तपस्वी नियतेन्द्रियः॥
en: There will be born in the race of Yayavaras, a great Rishi, known by the name of Jaratkaru, who will be intelligent, greatly ascetic and self-controlled.

sa: एवं पुरुषशार्दूलो महाबुद्धिर्जनार्दनः। पाण्डवैर्घातयामास जरासंधमरिं तदा॥
en: O king, thus did that best of men, the greatly intelligent Janardana (Krishna) cause his foe Jarasandha to be killed through the instrumentality of the Pandavas.

sa: स पक्षिसंघाचरितामाकाशं पूरयशरैः। धनंजयो महाबाहुः कुरूणामन्तकोऽभवत्॥
en: O king, Dhananjaya, filling the sky (which is the place for birds to play) with his arrows, seemed at that time the very destroyer of Kurus.

sa: नरनागाश्वमथनं परमं लोमहर्षणम्। द्रोणकर्णकृपा वीरा भीमपार्षतसात्यकाः॥
en: When that terrible destruction of men, horses, elephants and foot-soldiers was going on, those heroes viz., Drona, Karna, Kripa, Bhima, the son of Prishata and Satvata.

sa: बुभौ महेन्द्रप्रतिमौ महारथौ। महेन्द्र वृत्राविव सम्प्रजघ्नतुः॥
en: Both of them, mighty as the God Indra, assailed one another with weapons powerful as Indra's thunder and fought also like Indra himself and (Asura) Vritra.

sa: लज्जयाऽवनते चापि प्रत्दृष्टैश्चापि तावकैः। द्वीपो य आसीत् पांडूनामगाधे गधामेच्छतां॥
en: When then Parthas had been shamefully humiliated and when your troops were filled with delight, it was Satyaki that became the protector of the Pandavas solicitous of protection, for the king was then in the fathomless depth of distress.

sa: दृढज्यमानाभ्य समुद्रघोषं प्रादुश्चक्ते भार्गवास्त्रं महात्मा। श्छित्त्वा कर्णः पाण्डवस्येषुसंघान्॥ तस्यास्त्रमस्त्रेण निहत्य सोऽथ जघान संख्ये रथनागपत्तीन्। अमृष्यमाणश्च महेन्द्रकर्मा महारणे भार्गवास्त्रप्रतापात्॥
en: Then bending the strong stringed bow, the twang of which resembled the deep roar of the sea, he invoked the Bhargava weapon and cutoff all the shots coming out of the mouth of the Indra weapon (shot by Arjuna). He thus cut-off the weapons of his enemy, many of the cars, elephants and foot soldiers of the Pandava army by virtue of the Bhargava weapon, himself not being able to bear the prowess of Arjuna in that battle.

sa: प्रद्युम्नयुयुधानाभ्यामभिमन्योश्च भारत। अथास्येषु समाधत्त दृढं परमसम्मतम्॥ अन्तेवासिनमाचार्यो जिघांसुः पुत्रसम्मितम्। तं शरैर्दशभिस्तीक्ष्णैश्चिच्छेद शिनिपुङ्गवः॥
en: Pradyumna ard Yuyudhana possessed such arrows and also Abhimanyu had them. The preceptor then desirous of making an end of his pupil who was to him like his own son, placed on his bow-string, a strong shaft possessed of great violence. Satyaki however cut-off that saft with ten arrows of his own.

sa: विषण्णभूयिष्ठतरा धार्तराष्ट्री महाचमूः॥ रथाश्चैते सुवित्रस्ता भीमसेनभयार्दिताः।
en: The major portion of the huge army of Duryodhana is stricken with fear. The cars and horses assailed with Bhima's fear have been scattered all over.

sa: इति यः सततं मन्दमवोचल्लोभमोहितम्। दुर्योधनमवाचीनं राज्यकामुकमातुरम्॥
en: This (the above saying) he always uttered to Duryodhana, who was bad, darkened by avarice, foolish and desirous of kingdom and also who was highly afflicted.

sa: संजय उवाच तावका हि समीक्ष्यैवं वृष्ण्यन्धककुरूत्तमौ। प्रागत्वरञ्जिघांसन्तस्तथैव विजयः परान्॥
en: Sanjaya said Your warriors, as soon as they saw those two foremost heroes of the Vrishni-Andhaka and the Kuru races, quickly advanced against them, each striving to be the first. So also, Vijaya rushed against those foe of his.

sa: वेदवेदाङ्गविदुषः सत्यधर्मरतस्य ते। ब्राह्मणस्य विशेषेण तवैतन्नोपपद्यते॥
en: You are learned in the Vedas and their auxiliaries and devoted truth and righteousness specially you are a Brahman, so these acts do not become you.

sa: सुषेणशीर्षं पतितं पृथिव्यां विलोक्य कर्णोऽथ तदार्तरूपः। क्रोधाद्धयांस्तस्य रथं ध्वजं च बाणैः सुधारैर्निशितैरकृन्तत्॥
en: Overwhelmed with grief at the (ghastly) sight of the severed head of Sushena thus rolling on the ground. Karna remained stupefied (for a while), but, his avenging spirit soon taking the better of him, he, soon, with sharp-pointed arrows cut to pieces the steeds, chariot and the standard of his son's adversary.

sa: नृपस्य बाहू च शिरोऽथ च त्रिभिः। जघान षड्भिः षडनुत्तमत्विषः स पाण्ड्यराजानुचरान् महारथान्॥
en: He then cut-off the (four) feet and trunk of that elephant (belonging to his antagonist) with five arrows, as well as the arms and head of the king with three other shafts; and thereafter he siaughtered the nighty car-warriors, who accompanied king Pandya to the field and who, again, were highly resplendent.

sa: पञ्चालास्त्वेकतो द्रोणमभ्यमन् निशितैः शरैः॥ भीमसेनपुरोगाश्चाप्येकतः पर्यवारयन्।
en: Then the Panchalas, from one side began to assail Drona with their arrows, whilst those headed by Bhima began to check him on the other said,

sa: तथैवालायुधो राजशिलाधौतैरजिह्मगैः। अभ्यवर्षत कौन्तेयं पुनः पुनररिंदप॥
en: Similarly, O king, that subduer of foes namely, Alayudha, cutting off Bhima's arrows with straight going shafts of his, repeatedly covered the latter with his arrows.

sa: शुक्लाभिजनकर्माणो मतिमन्तो जनाधिप। धर्मयुद्धमयुध्यन्त प्रेप्सन्तो गतिमुत्तमाम्॥
en: Of stainless extraction and of spotless deeds and gifted with keen intelligence those rulers of men, keeping paradise in view, fought on fairly with one another.

sa: अङ्गाङ्गावयवैश्छिन्नायुधास्तेऽपतन भुवि। विष्वग्वाताभिसम्भग्ना बहुशाखा इव द्रुमाः॥
en: Deprived of all the limbs and weapons they began to fall down on earth like large trees of many big boughs hurled down by a hurricane.

sa: वातोद्धृतपताकं तं रथं जलदनिःस्वनम्। घोरं कपिध्वजं दृष्ट्वा विषण्णा रथिनोऽभवन्॥
en: Many warriors became greatly depressed, beholding that chariot, of which the banner fluttered in the air, the rattle of which resembled the rumble of clouds and which was mounted with that fearful standard having the ape for its device.

sa: प्रयुक्तांस्तान् प्रयत्नेन छित्वा द्रौणिरिषूनरिः। चक्ररक्षौ रणे तस्य प्राणुदनिशितैः शरैः॥
en: Then, again the antagonist of the son of Drona, after having severed those arrows shot (by his foe) most carefully, had slain in the battle the two protectors of his (enemy's) carwheels, by means of his own keen shafts.

sa: संजय उवाच भीष्पद्रोणकृपद्रौणिकर्णर्जुनजानर्दनान्। समाप्तविद्यान् धनुषि श्रेष्ठान् यान् मन्यसे रथान्॥
en: Sanjaya said You raged Bhishma, Drona, Kripa, the son of Drona, Karna, Arjuna and Janardana to be well versed in the knowledge of weapons and also to be the foremost of all bowmen and again, the best of car-warriors.

sa: दैवयोगात्तु ते बाणा नापतन् मर्मभेदिनः॥ प्रेषिता द्विजमुख्येन मर्माण्युद्दिश्य सर्वतः!
en: Those shafts, that were capable of piercing through the very vital part and that were shot by the foremost of the twice-born persons, aiming at all the vital parts, had not struck you through the favour of the celestials.

sa: ते वर्म हेमविकृतं भित्वा राज्ञः शिलाशिताः॥ विविशुर्वसुधां वेगात् कङ्कबर्हिणवाससः।
en: These shafts, set with the feathers of Kanka's (peacocks') and sharpened on stone, were discharged with such a force that cutting through the gold bedecked armour of the king, they ran through his body and entered into the earth.

sa: तान् समेतान् महेष्वासाशरवर्षांघवर्षिणः। एको व्यधमदाव्यग्रस्तमांसीव दिवाकरः॥
en: Like unto the rising sun dispelling darkness the single-handed Karna unhesitatingly encountered the united force of all those great warriors ceaselessly showering sharp shafts upon him.

sa: संजय उवाच नकुलमथ विदित्वा छिन्नबाणासनासिं विरतमरिशरात कर्णपुत्रास्त्रभग्नम्। पवनधुतपताकालादिनो वल्गिताश्वा वरपुरुषनियुक्तास्ते रथैः शीघ्रमीयुः॥ द्रुपदसुतवरिष्ठाः पञ्च शैनेयषष्ठा दुपददुहितृपुत्राः पञ्च चामित्रसाहाः। द्विरदरथनराश्वान् सूदयन्तस्त्वदीयान् भुजगपतिनिकाशैर्मार्गणैरात्तशस्त्राः॥
en: Sanjaya said Then those eleven mighty scorchers of enemies, namely the five brave sons of Drupada, the grandson of Shini (Satyaki) and the five sons of Draupadi, learning that Nakula had been made carless and greatly distressed and wounded with the shafts and other weapons of the son of Karna, his sword and bow broken, advanced on their rattling cars with standards floating in the air and pulled by jumping horses driven by skillful drivers. Those well-armed heroes with shafts deadly as snakes went on killing your elephants, chariots and men.

sa: स्थस्थयोर्द्वयोर्युद्धे क्रुद्धयोर्योधमुख्ययोः। केशवार्जुनयो राजन् समरे प्रेक्षमाणयोः॥
en: Those two foremost of car-warriors, both riding in their cars and both rushing with rage fought on with each other, Arjuna and Krishna being their witness.

sa: ततः शकुनिनिर्दिष्टाः सादिनः शूरसम्मताः। त्रिसाहस्त्राभ्ययुभीमं शक्त्यृष्टिप्रासपाणयः॥
en: Then three thousand cavalry led by Shakuni, held in esteem by all brave men and armed with darts, swords and lances, dashed on the great Bhima.

sa: आखण्डलधनुः प्रख्यमुल्लिशन्तमिवाम्बरम्। पश्य कर्ण समायान्तं धार्तराष्ट्रप्रियैषिणम्॥ शरधारा विमुञ्चन्तं धारासारमिवाम्बुदम्।
en: The banner like clouds and resembles the bow of Akhandal (Indra) which divides the sky and earth. See how Karna sends hosts of arrows like clouds pouring down rain as he is advancing fulfill the intention of Dhritarashtra's son.

sa: कुर्यात् तृणमयं चापं शयीत मृगशायिकाम्। अन्धः स्यादन्धवेलायां बाधिर्यमपि संश्रयेत्॥
en: He should make his bow of bamboos; he should sleep like the deer; he should be blind when it is necessary for him to be so, or he should even be deaf when it is necessary to be deaf.

sa: तेषामन्यतरापत्तौ यद् यदेवोपपद्यते। तदस्य चेतनामाशु हरत्यभ्रमिवानिलः॥
en: Although either of the two may overtake the person, yet whichever actually overtakes him quickly deprives him of his understanding like the wind dissipating gathering clouds.

sa: संनिमज्जेज्जगदिदं गम्भीरे कालसागरे। जरामृत्युमहाग्राहे न कश्चिदवबुध्यते॥
en: Alas, no one perceives that the world is sinking in the deep ocean of Time which is infested with those huge crocodiles called decrepitude and death.

sa: अत्यन्तं सुकुमारस्य राङ्कवाजिनशायिनः। कचिदद्य शरीरं ते भूमौ न परितप्यते॥
en: Addressing her own husband, she says again,-'You were reared up in every luxury. You used to sleep on soft skins of the Ranku deer. Alas, does not your body feet pain to-day by lying thus on this naked Earth.

sa: एकान्ततो ह्यमर्यादात् सर्वोऽप्युद्विजते जनः। दस्यवोऽप्यभिशङ्कन्ते निरनुक्रोशकारिणः॥
en: If the king disregards all healthy restraints, all people are filled with terror. They very robbers who know not what mercy is, fear such a king.

sa: अभिपिष्टैर्महानागैः समन्तात् पर्वतोपमैः॥ नातिप्रसिद्धैव गतिः पाण्डवानामजायत।
en: On account of those mighty elephants, huge as hills, falling down on every side with wounded limbs, the Pandava warriors found their way entirely blocked up.

sa: शरतल्पगतं भीष्ममूर्ध्वरेतसमच्युतम्। शयानं वीरशयने पश्य शूरनिषेविते॥
en: Look at that hero, O Krishna, who in knowledge of duty was equal to Devapi himself, now lying on a bed of arrows, worthy of heroes.

sa: तस्मात् सशेषं कर्तव्यं स्वाधीनमपि दस्युभिः। न बलस्थोऽहमस्मीति नृशंसानि समाचरेत्॥
en: Therefore, in dealing with robbers, it is necessary that they should not be destroyed outright. They should be gradually brought under the king's sway. The king should never treat them cruelly, thinking that he is more powerful than they.

sa: तत्र प्राज्ञोऽभिसंधत्ते सम्यग् बुद्धिसमाश्रयात्॥ अभिसंधीयते प्राज्ञः प्रमादादपि वा बुधैः।
en: In such a case the wise man succeeds by the power of his understanding in controlling the other. He, on the other hand, who has no। wisd m suffers himself, for his carelessness, to be defeated by the wise.

sa: ऋषि उवाच नित्यमुद्यतदण्डः स्यानित्यं विवृतपौरुषः। अच्छिद्रश्छिद्रदर्शी च परेषां विवरानुगः॥
en: The king should always remain with the rod of punishment in his hand. He should always show his prowess. Himself without shortcomings, he should mark those of his enemies. Indeed, his eye should always be used for that object.

sa: जर्जरीकृतसर्वाङ्गौ रुधिरेणाभिसप्लुतौ। दद्दशाते हिमवति पुष्पिताविव किंशुकौ॥
en: All their limbs wounded and bruised, and bathed in blood from head to foot, they looked like a couple of Kinshukas on the breast of Himavat.

sa: नन्दामि वः प्रभावेण पुत्राणामिव चोदये। यथाशक्त्युपगृह्णामि राष्ट्रस्यापीडया च वः॥
en: I am happy to see your prosperity, and I solicit you as I would my own children. I shall take from you what you can easily spare for me. I do not wish to give pain to any one.

sa: वने महति कस्मिंश्चिदमनुष्यनिषेविते। ऋषिर्मूलफलाहारो नियतो नियतेन्द्रियः॥
en: In a certain large forest uninhabited by human beings, there lived an ascetic upon fruits and roots, practising rigid vows and with his senses under restraint.

sa: विद्याधराः समुत्पेतुस्तस्य शृङ्गनिवासिनः। किन्नराश्च समुद्विग्नाः शक्तिपातरवोद्धताः॥
en: Vidyadharas living on its summits soared into the air. The Kinnaras also became very anxious, bewildered by the fear caused by the fall of Skanda's arrow.

sa: यद् वृत्तमुपजीवन्ति प्रकृतिस्थस्य मानवाः। तदेव विषमस्थस्य स्वजनोऽपि न मृष्यते॥
en: The conduct of a king, who observes his proper duties, is accepted by men in general as a model for imitation. The conduct, however, of a king, who deviates from his duties, is not tolerated by his very kinsmen.

sa: यश्च वेदप्रसूतात्मा स धर्मो गुणदर्शनः। धर्मप्रत्यय उद्दिष्टो यथाधर्मं कृतात्मभिः॥
en: That Vyavahara (Law), which originates from the Vedas, is Morality or duty. It yields good to persons believing in duty and morality; men of purified souls have spoken of that Vyavahara (Law) as they have done of ordinary law.

sa: निकाया भूतसंघानां परमाद्भुतदर्शनाः। विकृता विकृताकारा बिकृताभरणध्वजाः॥
en: Those goblins, of lean bodies, had wonderful features. They were ugly both in person and in features and bore on this person awkward ornaments and marks.

sa: मार्गमाणास्तु संक्रुद्धास्तव पुत्रं जयैषिणः॥ यत्नतोऽन्वेषमाणास्ते नैवापश्यञ्जनाधिपम्।
en: Filled with anger the Pandavas, desirous of victory, searched for your son. Though however, they searched carefully for him, they could not discover the Kuru king.

sa: शून्यरूपमपध्वस्तं दुःखाद् दुःखतरोऽभवत्॥ विदुरः सर्वधर्मज्ञो विकुवेनान्तरात्मना।
en: The cheerless place was shorn of beauty, comfort and happiness. It was all empty and disorderly. Already filled with grief, Vidura's sorrow increased at that spectacle.

sa: ततः शोकपरीतात्मा सधूम इव पावकः। निर्वेदमगमद् धीमान् राजा संतापपीडितः॥
en: Stricken with sorrow, the intelligent king, resembling a fire covered with smoke, was filled with despair. Then the wise king endued with grief like the fire covered in the grip of dense smoke and thus he sank in agony.

sa: स तत्र बहुभुिर्यक्तस्तदा श्रुतिमयैर्गुणैः। ब्राह्मणानामनुमतो देवर्षिसदृशोऽभवत्॥
en: Living there, king Vasuhoma acquired many pious attributes and, having gained the regard of the Brahmanas, came to be regarded as a celestial Rishi in holiness.

sa: दुर्मर्षणस्य भवनं दुःशासनगृहाद् वरम्। कुबेरभवनप्रख्यं मणिहेमविभूषितम्॥
en: The palace of Durmarshana was even superior to that Dushasana. Resembling the palace of Kubera himself, it was adorned with gold and every sort of gem.

sa: ततोऽभ्यधावंस्त्वरिताः पाण्डवा जयगृद्धिनः। पदातयश्च नागाश्च सादिनश्चोधतायुधाः॥
en: Thereat actuated with the desire of victory and endued with great activity, Pandavas rushed towards Shakuni, with foot-soldiers and elephants and cavalry all with uplifted weapons.

sa: प्रगृह्य शस्त्रमायान्तमपि वेदान्तगं रणे। जिघांसन्तं जिघांसीयान्न तेन ब्रह्महा भवेत्॥
en: If a Brahmana well acquainted with the Vedas takes up arins and tries to kill you in battle, you may proceed against him for taking his life. By such an act the slayer does not become guilty of Brahmanicide.

sa: विश्वकर्मन् नमस्तेऽस्तु विश्वात्मन् विश्वसम्भव। अपवर्गोऽसि भूतानां पञ्चानां परतः स्थितः॥
en: The universe is the work of your hand. You are the soul of the universe and the universe has originated from you. Salutations to you. You are the end of all created things. You are above the five elements.

sa: पांसुभिः समभिच्छन्नः शून्यागारप्रतिश्रयः। वृक्षमूलनिकेतो वा त्यक्तसर्वप्रियाप्रियः॥
en: Smearing my body with ashes, and living in forsaken houses, or lying at the foot of trees, I shall live, forsaking all things dear or hateful.

sa: ऐन्द्रो धर्मः क्षत्रियाणां ब्राह्मणानामथाग्निकः। ब्रह्मवह्निर्मम बलं भक्ष्यामि शमयन् क्षुधाम्॥
en: The Kshatriyas should follow the conduct of Indra. It is the duty of the Brahmanas to behave like Agni. The Vedas are fire. They form my strength. I shall, therefore, eat even this impure food for satisfying my appetite.

sa: काषायैरजिनैश्चीरैर्नग्नान् मुण्डान् जटाधरान्। बिभ्रत् साधून महाराज जय लोकान् जितेन्द्रियः॥
en: Therefore, O king, controlling your passions do you secure blissful regions for yourself hereafter by maintaining them that are truly pious amongst those having matted locks or clean-shaved heads, naked or clad in rags, or skins or brown clothes.

sa: अन्तःसर्प इवागारे वीरपत्न्या इवालये॥ शीलं जिज्ञासमानेन राज्ञश्च सहजीविनः। कच्चिज्जितेन्द्रियो राजा कच्चिदस्यान्तरा जिताः॥
en: Concealing the faults of your servants, I am living in your palace in constant dread of danger, even like a person living in a room with a snake within it or like the lover of a hero's wife. My object is to ascertain the behaviour of the king who lives with me.

sa: अशिष्टवदमर्यादः पापैः सह दुरात्मवान्। सभाया निर्गतो मूढो व्यतिक्रम्य सुहृद्वचः॥
en: That wicked-souled like, unmannerly man and without showing any respect for others, accompanied by those one an vicious companions, went out of the council hall and the fool did not pay any attention to the advice of his well-wishers.

sa: भृशमाश्वासयेश्चैनां पुत्रशोकपरिप्लुताम्। अभिवाद्य स्वजेथास्त्वं पाण्डवान् परिकीर्तयन्॥
en: Having saluted her first, embrace this lady and comfort her, who is filled with grief for her sons by talking again and again of the Pandavas.

sa: सहर्टयः सशृङ्गाश्च सप्रासविविधायुधाः। सकुठाराः सकुद्दालाः सतैलक्षौमसर्पिषः॥
en: With forbid pieces of wood, with excellent horses, with diverse weapons of offense and defense, with felling axes and spades and with oil-clothes, and clarified butter.

sa: नाग्निस्तृप्यति काष्ठानां नापगानां महोदधिः। नान्तकः सर्वभूतानां न पुंसां वामलोचना॥
en: One who cares for pleasures should renounce knowledge; and one that cares for knowledge should renounce pleases. Fire is never satiated with fuel; the great ocean, with rivers; death, with all the creatures; and a pretty woman, with men.

sa: सदेवासुरगन्धर्वा यक्षराक्षसपन्नगाः॥ कथयिष्यन्ति लोकास्त्वां यावद् भूमिर्धरिष्यति।
en: Therefore always the Asuras, Gandharvas, Yakshas, Rakshasas and the Punagas and all the world will speak (well) of you so long as the world will exist.

sa: धर्मज्ञो धृतिमान् प्राज्ञः सर्वभूतेषु केशवः। ईश्वरः सर्वभूतानां देवदेवः सनातनः॥
en: Who knows what virtue is, who is wise and endued with intelligence, who is cognizant of the inner working of the hearts of all beings, who is the lord of all creatures and the eternal god of the gods.

sa: मधुरानूषरे देशे प्रभूतयवसेन्धने। यथैव हास्तिनपुरं तद्वच्छिबिरमाबभौ॥
en: In a part which was also charming and without sands and abounded, fuel and fodder. The encampment then shone forth as the city of Hastina. son

sa: अशक्यमयशस्यं च सद्धिश्चापि विगर्हितम्। यथा त्वादृशको मूढो व्यवस्येत् कुलपांसनः॥
en: This intended act of yours is incapable of being performed, tending to infamy and disapproved by the honest in fact this is a thing which a fool and the cause of infamy to the race like you would attempt.

sa: गजाः पञ्चशतातत्र रथाश्चासन् सहस्रशः। प्रयान्तमन्वयुर्वीरं दाशार्हमपराजितम्॥
en: There were five hundred elephants and chariots by thousands, that came up behind the heroic scion of the Dasharha race, who had never sustained a defeat.

sa: शूलोद्यतकरः स्रग्वी हिरण्यकशिपुस्तदा॥ मेघस्तनितनि?षो नीलाभ्रचयसंनिभः। देवारिदितिजो वीरो नृसिंहं समुपाद्रवत्॥
en: Hiranyakashipu, the heroic son of Diti and the enemy of the celestials adorned with garlands and looking like a mass of dark clouds, rushed on that Being half lion, half . man, with an uplifted mace in his inand.

sa: कृतोदकानुजप्यः स हुताग्नि: समलंकृतः। ततश्चादित्यमुद्यन्तमुपातिष्ठत माधवः॥
en: Having performed his ablutions, having repeated the usual incantations to the god of fire and having donned his attire and ornaments, Madhava worshipped the rising sun.

sa: विललाप स राजेन्द्रस्तत्र कान्तामनुस्मरन्। कामबाणाभिसंतप्तः सौमित्रिस्तमथाब्रवीत्॥
en: O king of kings, smitten with Cupid's arrows by thinking of his beloved spouse he lamented (profusely). Then the son of Sumitra thus spoke to him.

sa: अयं पुनर्मत्तगजेन्द्रगामी प्रतप्तचामीकरशुद्धगौरः। वृकोदरः पश्यत पश्यतैनम्॥
en: He, who courses like an infuriated elephant, whose complexion is bright like burning gold, whose shoulders are expansive, whose arms are long and heavy, is Vrikodara.

sa: अहं च त्वाऽनुयास्यामि सर्वे चान्धकवृष्णयः। दाशार्हाः परिवारास्ते दाशार्णाश्च विशाम्पते॥
en: I too shall follow you as also all the Andhakas and the Vrishinis and the members of the Dasharha race as also of the Dasharna race will be among the members of your family, O lord of the universe.

sa: भृत्यैर्वाणिज्यचारं च पुत्रैः सेवेत च द्विजान्। अद्ध्योऽग्निर्ब्रह्मतः क्षत्रमश्मनो लोहमुस्थितम्॥
en: The guests who carry on commerce should be waited on by servants; but the quests of the twice-born caste by one's sons. Out of water has arisen fore; and out of Brahma, the Kshatriya; and out of stone, iron.

sa: मैन्दा द्विविदश्चापि हनूमांश्चानिलात्मजः। जाम्बवानृक्षराजश्च सुग्रीवसचिवाः स्थिताः॥
en: (Moreover), Mainda, Dvivida, Hanuman, the son of the wind god and Jambuvana, the king of the bears, all these counsellors of Sugriva stand up for him.

sa: विद्याशीलवयोवृद्धान् बुद्धिवृद्धांश्च भारत। धनाभिजातवृद्धांश्च नित्यं मूढोऽवमन्यते॥
en: Fools have ever made light of those who are learned, old in age, old in intelligence, superior in wealth in wealth and in birth, O Bharata.

sa: एवंविधानां दुःखानापभिज्ञोऽसि जनार्दन। त्रायस्व पुण्डरीकाक्ष सभर्तृज्ञातिबान्धवान्॥
en: You, O Janardana, are very well aware of such-like troubles; and save us, o you with eyes like lotus, along with my husbands, kinsmen and friends.

sa: त्यक्तवाक्यानृतस्तात शुभकल्याणमङ्गलः। शुभार्थेप्सुः शुभमतिर्यत्र राजा युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: Where the king Yudhishthira is, people, renouncing untruth, shall acquire what is good, auspicious and beneficial and thus good mind shall be inclined towards the good.

sa: धर्मार्थयुक्तं तथ्यं च यथा त्वय्युपद्यते। तथा वचनमुक्तोऽस्मि त्वयैतत् पितृमातृवत्॥
en: This has the merit of being conversant with morality and worldly good and truth to that degree which proper for you; the words which have been spoken by you are like the advice of a father or a mother.

sa: तेष्वेवमुपपन्नेषु कामक्रोधानुवर्तिषु। समर्थमपि ते वाक्यमसमर्थं भविष्यति॥
en: Among those who are thus endued and who follow the impulse of desire and anger, your words though able in themselves will be of no use.

sa: मन्ये वाच्यो यद् युधिष्ठिरशासनम्। धर्मराजेन भारत॥
en: I think that Yudhishthira's message ought to be conveyed to him; what is necessary and proper has already been said by the virtuous king, O Bharata.

sa: रावणो राममानर्छच्छक्तिशूलासिवृष्टिभिः। निशितैरायसैस्तीक्ष्णै रावणं चापि राघवः॥
en: Ravana afflicted Rama with a downpour of darts, lances and swords and the descendant of Raghu too oppressed Ravana with sharpened iron darts having keen points.

sa: जातिगृद्ध्याभिपन्नाश्च पाण्डवानामनेकशः। धर्मादयः समेष्यन्ति समाहूता दिवौकसः॥
en: Out of affection for those born of them Dharma and many other dwellers of the heaven will, when invoked, come on the side of the Pandavas.

sa: अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। मातलेर्दातुकामस्य कन्या मृगयतो वरम्॥
en: In this connection is cited the old story of Matali who was desirous of giving away his daughter in marriage and was searching for a bridegroom.

sa: नश्वत्थाम्ना शल्यकृपादिभिश्च। रणे विजेतुं विषहेत राजन् राधेयगुप्तान् सह भूमिपालैः॥
en: Who, on the other hand, can withstand with a view to conquer in battle, the Kurus, who are protected by Drona, Bhishma, Ashvathama, Shalya, Kripa and others and also protected by the son of Radha along with other kings.

sa: एतद् द्वितीयं देवस्य द्वारमाचक्षते द्विज। त्रुटिशो लवशश्चापि गण्यते कालनिश्चयः॥
en: This direction is said to be the second gate to virtue, O twice born one and here does the king of death, with a sure hand, calculate the life allotted to men, in Trutis and Lavas (periods of time).

sa: अधर्मोपार्जितैरथैर्यः करोत्यौदेहिकम्। न स तस्य फलं प्रेत्य भुङ्क्तेऽर्थस्य दुरागमात्॥
en: He who performs ceremonies for his good in the other world with wealth got by foul means. Dose not get the usual fruits of such ceremonies after death owing to the foul means by which the wealth was got.

sa: सर्वार्थानां व्याकरणाद् वैयाकरण उच्यते। तन्मूलतो व्याकरणं व्याकरोतीति तत् तथा॥
en: That man is said to be a grammarian who can trace each word to its root and explain it. Similarly that man is a true grammarian who can trace each object to its root (Brahma or the Supreme Soul).

sa: इतिकर्तव्यतां चेति देशकालविभागवित्। नाभिपेदे महाबाहुश्चिन्तयानो महामतिः॥
en: And though that high-minded one of mighty arms, acquainted with the divisions of time and place, pondered much, he could not settle what he should do.

sa: तं कार्मुकमहावेगमस्त्रज्वलितपावकम्। द्रोणमासादयांचक्रुः पञ्चालाः पाण्डवैः सह॥
en: Then the Pandavas along with the Panchalas, rushed at Drona wielding a bow of great strength and resembling a blazing fire in consequence of his weapons.

sa: पादाताश्च तथा शूरा नानाप्रहरणध्वजाः। नानादेशसमुत्पन्नास्त्वदर्थे योद्धुमुद्यताः॥
en: And many heroic foot-soldiers accomplished in the use of various kinds of weapons, and born in various countries, are all prepared to fight for your sake.

sa: सोऽश्वमेधसहस्रेण राजसूयशतेन च। पुण्यैः क्षत्रिययज्ञेश्च प्रभूतवरदक्षिणैः॥
en: Having celebrated thousand horsesacrifices, a hundred Rajasuya sacrifices and, numerous other Kshatriya sacrifices, in all of a which he gave away vast wealth as sacrificial presents.

sa: काम्बोजैः शबलैरश्वैरभ्यवर्तत दुर्जयः। बृक्षत्रं तु कैकेयं सुकुमारं हयोत्तमाः॥ पलालधूमसंकाशाः सैन्धवाः शीघ्रमावहन्। मल्लिकाक्षाः पद्मवर्णा बाह्निजाता: स्वलंकृताः॥
en: And invincible in battle, was carried by horses of Kamboja breed and of variegated hue. Excellent steeds of thc Sindhu breed, of beautiful limbs and of the colour of the smoke emitted by burning straws, quickly bore the prince of the Kekayas, namely, Vrihatkshastra. Possessed of eyes of the hue of jasmine, of lotus hue, of Valhika breed and decked with gold trappings, such steeds.

sa: तस्य पार्थो धनुश्छित्त्वा केतुं चिच्छेद मारिष॥
en: He once more pierced Vasudeva's son with three and Partha with five arrows, then O Sire, Pritha's son bursting open his bow, cut down his standard;

sa: ततोऽपश्यं जामदग्न्यं रथमध्ये व्यवस्थितम्। सर्वायुधवरे श्रीमत्यद्भुतोपमदर्शने॥
en: Then did I see the son of Jamadagni seated on a car holding all the principal weapons, endued with beauty and appearing wonderful to the sight.

sa: सिंहलाङ्ग्लमाकाशे ज्वलन्तमिव पर्वतम्। असज्जमानं वृक्षेषु धूमकेतुमिवोत्थितम्॥ बहुवर्णं विचित्रं च दिव्यं वानरलक्षणम्। अपश्याम महाराज ध्वजं गाण्डीवधन्वनः॥
en: O mighty monarch, we then beheld the standard of that wielder of the Gandiva bow, standard that resembled a lion's tail in shape and looked like a blazing mountain in the air; that could not be obstructed by the trees; that appeared like the risen comet; and that was of diverse hue and variegated and of celestial make and bore the device of the monkey.

sa: शङ्खदुन्दुभिनिर्घोषस्तुमुल: सर्वतोऽभवत्। तृप्तः शान्तनवश्चापि राजन् बीभत्सुमब्रवीत्॥
en: And the sound of drums and the blare of conchs on all sides became deafening. Then, O king, Shantanu's son, being greatly gratified, thus addressed Vibhatsu,

sa: तस्य दौःशासनिर्विद्ध्वाचतुर्भिश्चतुरो हयान्। सूतमेकेन विव्याध दशभिश्चार्जुनात्मजम्॥
en: Thereupon the son of Drona pierced his four horses with four arrows and charioteer with one shaft and then he pierced Arjuna's son with ten arrows.

sa: स्रग्भिराभरणैर्वस्त्रैः पातितैश्च महाभुजैः। वर्मभिश्चर्मभिर्हारैर्मुकुटेश्छत्रचामरैः॥ उपस्करैरधिह्मनैरीषादण्डकबन्धुरैः। अक्षैर्विमाथितैश्चर्भग्नश्च :॥ अनुकर्षैः पताकाभिस्तथा सारथिवाजिभिः। रथैश्च भग्नै गैश्च हतैः कीर्णाऽभवन्मही॥
en: With garlands of flowers and ornaments and cloths, with all standards lopped off, with armours and bucklers and golden chains and diadems and umbrellas and chamaras, with yokes and braces and shafts and axels of cars, with shattered wheels Akshas and yokes by thousands, with Arnukarshas, pennons and fallen charioteers and steeds, with broken cars, with clephants steeds, the earth then became literally covered over.

sa: न क्रियाभिर्न चास्त्रेण मृत्योः कश्चिनिवार्यते। लोकसम्भावितौ वीरौ कृतास्त्रौ युद्धदुर्मदौ॥
en: Nor by the performance of rites or by the dint of weapons, can any one be saved from Death. Those two heroes, held in high honour by the worlds, accomplished in the use of Weapons and invincible in battle.

sa: ततः पार्वाद् वृषाङ्कस्य ब्रह्मचारी न्यवर्तत। पिङ्गाक्षस्तपसः क्षेत्रं बलवान् नीललोहितः॥
en: Thereafter from one of the sides of Siva's body, a Brahmacharin issued forth; his eyes were tawny and he seemed to be the refuge of all asceticism. Having blue throat and red hair, he was possessed of great energy.

sa: तयोर्युद्धं समभवन्नागयोर्भीमरूपयोः॥ सपक्षयोः पर्वतयोर्यथा सदुपयोः पुरा।
en: Then the encounter that ensued between those two elephants of prodigious appearance, resembled the fight, in the days of yore, between winged mountains covered with trees.

sa: ततः प्रववृते युद्धं परस्परवधैषिणाम्॥ कुरुपाण्डवसैन्यानां शब्देनापूरूज्जगत्।
en: Thereafter the fight between the Kurus and the Pandus, both desirous of killing one another, commenced; and the terrible din rising therefrom filled the whole world.

sa: पञ्चानां द्रोपदेयानां प्रतिमा ध्वजभूषणम्। धर्ममारुतशक्राणामश्विनौश्च महात्मनोः॥
en: The standards of the five sons of Draupadi bore as their device the beautiful images of Dharma, Maruta, Shakra and of the twin Ashvins of high-soul.

sa: परिपेतुः सुसंरब्धाश्चतुर्दष्ट्राश्चतुर्दिशम्। भगदत्तस्य तं नागं विषाणैरभ्यपीडयन्॥
en: Each possessed of four tusks, fell from all sides, with fury, upon the elephants of Bhagadatta, striking the latter at the same time with their tusks.

sa: तामस्य विशिखैस्तूर्णं पातयामास भारत। रथादनवरूढस्य तदद्भूतमिवाभवत्॥
en: But, O descendant of Bharata, before he could come down from his car, Drona cut down his mace into may fragments. It was a wonderful feat.

sa: द्रोणादस्त्रभृतां श्रेष्ठात् सर्वशस्त्रभृतामपि। अन्यच्च ब्रूयां राजेन्द्र प्रतिज्ञां मम निश्चलाम्॥
en: Moreover, O foremost of kings, I say that my resolution is decided. I never think of perjuring myself; I never think of my defeat. I never think of keeping the least part, of any vow I may take, unredeemed.

sa: तान्यर्जुनः सहस्राणि दशपञ्चभिराशुगैः। अनागतान्येव शरैश्चिच्छेदाशु पराक्रमी॥
en: Thereupon Arjuna, capable of manifesting with lightness his prowess in battle, severed t'hose thousand arrows before they could reach him, with fifteen swift-coursing shafts of his.

sa: योधाश्च भद्रकाराश्च शरदण्डानुदण्डयः। श्वेताण्डाः कुक्कुटाण्डाभादण्डकेतुं हयाऽवहन्॥
en: Metted chargers of gentle appearance, possessed of vertebral columns erect like reedstalks, having white tests and endued with the colour of the hen's eggs, bore Dandaketu.

sa: इन्द्रियाणि मनो बुद्धिरस्याधिष्ठानमुच्यते। एतैर्विमोहयत्येष ज्ञानमावृत्य देहिनम्॥
en: It is said that its seat is in the senses, in the mind and in the understanding. By their help it deludes man, enveloping his knowledge.

sa: निस्त्रिंशवेगाभिहतौ ततस्तौ पुरुषर्षभौ। धरणीं समनुप्राप्तौ सर्वभूतनिषेविताम्॥
en: Then those two foremost of men, struck with the vehemence of one another's swords (blows) fell down on the earth inhabited by all sorts of creatures.

sa: तम निदशभिर्युयुन्सुर्दशभिः शरैः। त्रिभिस्त्रिभिौपदेया धृष्टकेतुश्च विव्यधुः॥
en: Then the son of Arjuna pierced him with twelve shafts and Yuyutsu with ten. The sons of Draupadi and Dhrishtaketu also pierced him with ten shafts.

sa: रुक्मपीठावकीर्णास्तु कौशेयसदृशा हयाः। सुवर्णमालिनः क्षान्ता: श्रेणिमन्तमुदावहन्॥
en: Quiet steeds of the hue of red silk, decked with chains of gold and having their backs covered with armour of the same metal, bore Shreniman.

sa: छन्नमायोधनं राजन् कुण्डलाङ्गदधारिभिः। पतितैः पात्यमानैश्च राजपुत्रैर्महारथैः॥
en: The field of battle, O king, became strewn with fallen and falling bodies of many royal car-warriors even then decked with bracelets and graced with ear-rings.

sa: चेदिपो वसुदानश्च दशार्णाधिपतिस्तथा। सुप्रतीकेन तांश्चापि भगदत्तोऽप्युपाद्रवत्॥
en: Vasudeva, the ruler of the Chedis, the ruler of the Dasharnas, all these warriors assaulted Bhagadatta. Bhagadatta also mounted on his elephant Supratika, charged these heroes.

sa: प्रमथ्य च विषाणाप्रैः समुत्क्षिप्ताश्च वारणैः। सचक्राश्च विचक्राश्च रथैरेव महारथाः॥
en: A number of elephants threw the chariots of huge size either with or without wheels with charioteers and warriors rode on them by lifting upon the tusk and tossed through the trunk. All those were thus, splitted into pieces.

sa: र्भयाद् द्रवद्भिर्जनितोऽतिभैरवः। क्षितिवियद् द्यां विदिशोदिशस्तथा समावृणोत् पार्थिव संयुगे ततः॥
en: O monarch, then in that battle, a loud din, was raised by the elephants, car-warriors steeds and kings, as they fled in fear; and that din filled the earth, the welkin, the cardinal and subsidiary directions of the compass.

sa: गात्राभ्यन्तरगो भूत्वा करेणाताडयन्मुहुः। लालयामास तं नागं वधाकाक्षिणमव्ययम्॥ कुलालचक्रवन्नागस्तदा तूर्णमथाभ्रमत्। नागायुतबलःश्रीमान् कालयानो वृकोदरम्॥
en: He began to afflict that elephant that was intent on slaying him; Whereupon the elephant began to whirl round like a potter's wheel in rapid motion. Possessed of the might of ten thousand elephants, the glorious Vrikodara, having struck the elephant. Came out from underneath its body and stood stood before Supratika.

sa: सर्वमूर्धाभिषिक्तानां सम्मत: सोऽभवद्युधि। अयजच्चाश्वमेधैर्यो विजित्य पृथिवीमिमाम्॥
en: In battle he came to be recognised as the head of all the Kshatriya. Having brought the entire earth under his control, he performed many Horse-sacrifices.

sa: प्रवपन्निव बीजानि बीजकाले नरर्षभ। द्रोणायनिद्रौपदेयं शरवर्षैरवाकिरत्॥
en: O foremost of men, like a sower sowing seeds in the sowing season. The son of Draupadi, covered the son of Drona with an arrowy downpour.

sa: नासज्जन्त तनुत्रेषु भीष्मचापच्युताः शराः। हतवीरान् रथान् राजन् संयुक्ताञ्जवनैर्हयैः॥ अपश्याम महाराज ह्रियमाणान् रणाजिरे। चेदिकाशिकरूषाणं सहस्राणि चतुर्दश॥ महारथाः समाख्याताः कुलपुत्रास्तनुत्यजः। अपरावर्तिनः सर्वे सुवर्णविकृतध्वजाः॥ संग्रामे भीष्ममासाद्य व्यादितास्यमिवान्तकम्। निमग्नाः परलोकाय सवाजिरथकुञ्जराः॥
en: Then the arrows, shot from the bow of Bhishma, did not only strike against the armours of combatants but penetrated through them. We saw, O monarch, many cars dragged over the field, by the fleet steeds that were harnessed to them, in consequence of the death of the heroes that rode them. Four and ten thousand car-warriors belonging to the Chedis, the Kashis and the Karushas, all well-known, and born of illustrious family, never retreating from field and owners of golden standards, prepared to lay down their lives in battle, encountering Bhishma who looked like Death himself with mouth wide open, were all dispatched to the regions of the departed along with their steeds, cars and elephants.

sa: लोकापवादभीतस्य तव राम महाव्रत। प्रत्ययं दास्यते सीता तामनुज्ञातुमर्हसि ॥
en: O Rāma of firm vows, you are afraid of the censure of the people. Sitā has becoming willing to give testimony (of her purity) for removing the calumny of the public; do you mercifully give her permission in this.

sa: तत एकान्तमुन्नीय पाराशर्यो युधिष्ठिरम। अब्रवीदुपपन्नार्थमिदं वाक्यविशारदः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : That foremost of all eloquent men, the son of Parasara (Vyasa), taking him aside thus spoke to Yudhishthira in words of deep import.

sa: स च्छिन्नधन्वा विरथो हताश्वो हतसारथिः॥ जग्राह गिरिशृङ्गाभं परिघं रोमहर्षणम्। वेष्टितं काञ्चनैः पट्टैर्देवसैन्याभिमर्दनम्॥ आयसैः शङ्कुभिस्तीक्ष्णैः कीर्णं परवसोक्षितम्। वज्राशनिसमस्पर्श परगोपुरदारणम्॥
en: His bow cut off, his steeds together with the charioteer slain, and himself deprived of his car, he (Dūşana) took a parigha resembling a mountain peak, able to me one's down stand on end plated with gold, capable of afflicting celestial hosts, studded with sharp iron sankus, and graced with the fal of foes;-of the touch of a thunder-bolt, able to pierce the persons of enemies*. The text may also mean able to rend the cities of foes.

sa: पाण्डुरैश्चापि व्यजनैर्वीज्यमानो नराधिप। शुक्लवासाः सितोष्णीषः सर्वशुक्लविभूषणः॥
en: I was also fanned by white fans, O ruler of men. I was clad with white garments, white head dress and all my ornaments were white.

sa: उक्तश्च मानुषेण त्वं पथा गच्छेत्यविस्मितः। न प्रभावेण गन्तव्यमन्तरिक्षचरेण वै॥
en: Before he started, his father further told him,-Do you go there be that path which ordinary human beings follow. Do not have recourses to your Yoga-power for proceeding through the skies. At this Shuka was not at all surprised.

sa: शयानमभितः शूरं कालिङ्गं मधुसूदन। पश्य दीप्ताङ्गदयुगप्रतिनद्धमहाभुजम्॥
en: Behold, O destroyer of Madhu, the heroic king of the Kalingas lying there on the ground, with his mighty arms bedecked with a couple of Angadas.

sa: जरायुजाण्डजाश्चैव स्वेदजाश्च तथोद्भिजाः। त्वमेव देवदेवेश भूतग्रामश्चतुर्विधः॥
en: O Lord of all the lords of the gods, you are the four orders of living creatures, viz., the viviparous, the oviparous, the filth-born, and vegetables.

sa: अवज्ञानसहौस्तु दोषाः कष्टतराऽधने। धने सुखकला या तु सापि दुःखैर्विधीयते॥
en: With all sorts of humiliation numbering by thousands, there are many other faults in property which are even much more painful. On the other hand, the very small happiness that resides in wealth is mingled with pain and sorrow.

sa: इदमन्तरमित्येवं हर्तुं चक्रे मनस्तदा। अथाग्निशरणेऽपश्यज्ज्वलन्तं जातवेदसम्॥
en: He thought this very good opportunity to carry the lady away. Then he entered into the room of the holy fire where it was brightly burning.

sa: हिरण्यरेताः पुरुषस्त्वमेव त्वं स्त्री पुमांस्त्वं च नपुंसकं च। स्त्वं नागेन्द्र शक्रस्त्वं विश्वकृद्धिश्वकर्ता॥
en: Gold is your seminal fluid. You are male, you are female, you are neuter. You are an infant, you are a youth, you are old in years with your teeth gone, you are the foremost of Nagas, you are Shakra, you are the Destroyer of the universe, and you are its Creator.

sa: स प्रस्थितः केशवेनानुशिष्टो मदातुरो ज्ञातिवधार्दितश्च। तं विश्रान्तं संनिधौ केशवस्य दुरन्तमेकं सहसैव बभ्रम्॥ ब्रह्मानुशप्तमवधीन्महद् वै कूटे युक्तं मुसलं लुब्धकस्य।
en: Thus orderded by Keshava, Vabhru still helpless with wine but cheerless at the destruction of his kinsmen, wen away. He had rested for a while by the side of Keshava, but as soon as he had gone to a distance the ironbolt, attached to a mallet in the hands of a hunter, suddenly sprang of itself upon that solitary survivor of the Yadava family and killed him who also had been included in the curs of the Brahmans.

sa: बहुयोजनसाहस्रं क्रान्नेव गतोम्बरम्। पितुर्बलाच्च बाल्यच्च भास्कराभ्याशमागतः।।२९
en: Rising high up in the sky on account of childish freaks and traversed many thousand leagues by the help of his father Hanuman neared the sun.

sa: स्वाध्यायेन कर्शितं ब्रह्मचारिणं मां विद्धि। तपसा दमेन युक्तमाचार्यस्याप्रतिकूलभाषिणम्। एवं युक्तमपापं मां विद्धिा॥
en: Know me as one who is learned in the Vedas, as one leading the life of a Brahmachari, as one who possesses selfcontrol and asceticism. Know me also as one who have never spoken a harsh word to his preceptor, as one possessed of every virtue and as one that is sinless.

sa: क्षुधया पीड्यमानस्तु नलो बहुतिथेऽहनि। अपश्यच्छकुनान् कांश्चिद्धिरण्यसदृशच्छदान्॥
en: Afflicted sore with (the pangs of) hunger, after the lapse of many days, Nala saw some birds, the colour of whose plumage resembled that of gold.

sa: अव्युत्पन्नं समानार्थं तुल्यमित्रं युधिष्ठिरम्। अद्विषन्तं कथं द्विष्यात् त्वादृशो भरतर्षभ॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, Yudhishthira does not know what deception is; he possesses wealth equal to yours; he has your friends for his; and he is not jealous of you. Why then are you jealous of him?

sa: मन्युना च महाभीमा महाकाली महेश्वरी॥ आत्मनः कर्मसाक्षित्वे तेन सार्धं सहानुगा। देवस्थानुमतं मत्वा प्रणम्य शिरसा ततः॥
en: Urged by her anger, the wife of Maheshvara, herself assuming a dreadful form known by the name of Mahakali, proceeded in the company of that Being who had come out from Mahadeva's mouth, for beholding with her own eyes the acts of destruction which was her own. That powerful Being, then started having gained the permission of Mahadeva and having bowed his head to him.

sa: निर्वाणं परमं ब्रह्म धर्मोऽसौ पर उच्यते। तस्मान्न च्युतपूर्वोऽहमच्युतस्तेन कर्मणा॥
en: The cessation of separate conscious existence by identification with Supreme Brahma is the highest stage for a living agent to acquire. And since I have never swered from that condition, I am, therefore, called by the name of Achyuta.

sa: विदुर उवाच नाभिनन्दे नृपते प्रैषमेतं मैवं कृथाः कुलनाशाद् बिभेमि। देतच्छङ्के द्यूतकृते नरेन्द्र॥
en: Vidura said O king, I do not approve of your this command. Do not act thus. I am afraid this will bring about the destruction of our race. O ruler of men, I apprehend that your sons will lose unity from this match at dice; and dissension will certainly arise amongst them.

sa: उभयोरपि राजेन्द्र सम्बन्धेनानुबध्यताम्। इक्ष्वाकुकुलमव्यग्रं भवतः पुण्यकर्मणः॥
en: Therefore do you, O foremost of sovereigns, by this alliance with both the brothers, bind the Ikşvāku race. And in this may your mind never waver!

sa: जातपक्षा विदेशस्था विवृद्धाः सर्वशोऽद्य ते। नोपायसाध्याः कौन्तेया ममैषा मतिरच्युत॥
en: They are now living at a distance, they are now grown up and they are now stronger by securing allies. It is my firm belief that you will not be able to injure them now with any subtle machinations.

sa: प्राज्ञौ मेधाविनौ दान्तावर्थकामौ बहुश्रुतौ। आहतुस्त्वां हितं वाक्यं तज्जुषस्व नराधिप।॥
en: The two are wise, have intelligence, have their souls under control, know what leads to are, as virtue and to worldly good and they are vastly learned; they have told you beneficial words; O ruler of men, accept them.

sa: मानुषी मानुषं तं तु राममिच्छसि शोभने। राज्याद् भ्रष्टमसिद्धार्थं विक्लवन्तमनिन्दिते॥
en: You are a woman, O you of comely presence, and therefore dose your fancy cling to Rāma, O you of a blameless countenance, who is a man, deprived of his kingdom, overwhelmed with disasters and has his desires frustrated.

sa: तीक्ष्णसायकनिर्भिन्नाशूलशक्त्वृष्टिसायकैः। अद्य वो गमयिष्यामि सर्वानेव यमक्षयम्॥
en: To-day with your persons pierced with sharp shafts, with darts, and javelins, and Rstis and arrows, Shall I despatch you all to the abode of Yama.

sa: स तु शूलगदाप्रासाञ्छक्तितोमरसायकान्। मुमोच च शिलावृक्षान्मुमोचास्त्रबलाद्बली॥
en: Thereat that powerful one, by virtue of his mastery over weapons, began to hurl darts and maces, prāsas and spears and tomaras and crags and trees.

sa: सुकेशपुत्रैर्भगवन्पितामहवरोद्धतैः। प्रजाध्यक्ष प्रजाः सर्वा बाध्यन्ते रिपुबाधनैः॥ शरणान्यशरण्यानि आश्रमाणि कृतानि नः। स्वर्गाच्च देवान्प्रच्याव्य स्वर्गे क्रीडन्ति देववत्॥
en: O reverend one, the creatures of the lord of creatures are being (sorely) troubled by the sons of Sukesa, given to harassing their foes,-swolen with insolence on account of the benn conferred on them by the great-father, asylums, constituting our refuges,-have been divested of their power of granting shelter, and driving off the deities from the etherial regions, they are sporting there like the immortals.

sa: परिधैर्मथिताः केचिद्भिन्दिपालैश्च दारिताः। पट्टिशैर्मथिताः केचिद्विह्वलन्तो गतासवः॥
en: Some were beaten hard with bludgeons; and some were cleft with bhindipālas. And some, on being assailed with bearded darts, became insensible and lost their lives.

sa: द्युतिमानेतदाख्याय रामो वानरसंयुतः। हृष्टपुष्टजनाकीर्णामयोध्यां प्रविवेश सः॥
en: Having related thus (the works of the monkeys) the graceful Rāma encircled by the monkeys entered (the city of) Ayodhya abounding in delighted and plump persons.

sa: सप्राकारमवप्लुत्य पश्यामि बहुपादपम्। अशोकवनिकामध्ये शिंशपापादपो महान्॥
en: And leaping over the wall, I saw a grove rife with trees; and (at last) saw in the midst of an aśoka wood a great ſinsapā.

sa: शतं शतसहस्राणां पृतनार्शवनौकसाम्। लङ्काद्वाराण्युपाजग्मुरन्ये योद्धं समन्ततः॥
en: And hundreds and thousands making up the army of monkeys, arrived at the gate of Lanka; while others were pouring in from all sides for encounter.

sa: अथ तेषु ब्रुवाणेषु रावणावरजोऽब्रवीत्। वाक्यमग्राम्यपदवत्पुष्कलार्थं बिभीषणः॥
en: We are here daily nearing Răvaņa, lord of Raksasas. As they were speaking thus, Ravana's younger brother, Vibhīşaņa, said in a pregnant speech free from provinicialism.

sa: गजेन्द्रैः पर्वताकारैः पर्वताग्रैर्वनौकसाम्। मथितैर्वाजिभिः कीर्णं सारोहैर्वसुधातलम्॥
en: And (anon) the earth was covered with huge elephants measuring mountains, and mountaintops, and steeds crushed and the riders thereof, all borne down by the monkeys.

sa: एतागच्छत गच्छामो वानरानतिदर्पितान्। बलेनावारयिष्यामि प्रभुञ्जानान् मधूत्तमम्॥
en: Proceed you before, I shall soon follow you and repress by force all those monkeys, greatly excited with pride and the drinking of the excellent honey.

sa: तद्रावणकरान्मुक्तं विद्युन्मालासमावृतम्। अष्टघण्टं महानादं वियद्गतमशोभत। ५९॥
en: And discharged from Ravana's hand, (the dart), surrounded with garlands of lighting furnished with eight bells, sending mighty roars, rising to the sky, looked exceedingly splendid.

sa: तयोः शिखरयोर्मध्ये प्रदीप्तमतुलप्रभम्। सौषधियुतं वीर द्रक्षस्योषधिपर्वतम्॥
en: Lying in the lap of these two, you, O hero, O powerful monkey, will see the mountain of medicines, fraught with healing herbs of all kinds.

sa: चूत'नागसुरभिर्बकुलोत्तमसंयुतः। मृष्टान्नरससंयुक्तः पानगन्धपुरःसरः॥ तस्य राक्षसराजस्य निश्चक्राम महामुखात्। शयानस्य विनिःश्वासः पूरयन्निव तद् गृहम्॥
en: And breath bearing the aroma of the mango, and the Punnāga, the sweet scent of the Bakula, the savour of viands fraught with the six kinds of tastes, and the perfume of wines, came out of the mighty mouth of the sovereign of the Rākşasas, filling as it were, that entire chamber.

sa: विशेषमालम्ब्य विशेषसंस्थितं विचित्रकूटं बहुकूटमण्डितम्। मनोऽभिरामं शरदिन्दुनिर्मलं विचित्रकूटं शिखरं गिरेर्यथा॥
en: Coursing through the firmament in a variety of ways, the congeries of all wonderful things, adorned with ranges of chambers; captivating to the mind; stainless as the autumnal Moon; furnished with splendid summits, like the crest of a mountain.

sa: श्रेयो मे जीवितान्मर्तुं विहीनाया महात्मना। रामादक्लिष्टचारित्राच्छूराच्छत्रुनिबर्हणात्॥
en: Death is more preferable to me than life since. I have been separated from the high-souled heroic Rāma, of unblemished character and the slayer of foes.

sa: चतुर्ध्वपि समुद्रेषु संध्यामन्वास्य वानरः। रावणोद्वहनश्रान्तः किष्किन्धोपवनेऽपतत्॥
en: Having gone through his Sandhyā rites at the four oceans and carrying Răvaņa, that monkeychief was greatly exhausted and (therefore) descended into the gardens of Kişkindhā.

sa: अहमाश्वासयाम्येनां पूर्णचन्द्रनिभाननाम्। अदृष्टदुःखां दुःखस्य न हन्तमधिगच्छतीम्।७।।
en: I shall console this damsel, having the countenance of the full moon, who had never seen grief before, and who shall not soon reach its end.

sa: स चारुनानाविधरूपधारी परं समासाद्य समुद्रतीरम्। परैरशक्यं प्रतिपन्नरूपः समीक्षितात्मा समवेक्षितार्थः॥
en: Thus wearing various graceful forms, that one, acting after reflection, having come to the other shore of the ocean incapable of being reached by others, on looking over his (immensely magnified person), reduced his body (to its former size).

sa: सत्यधर्मरतः श्रीमान् संग्राहनुग्रहे रतः। देशकालविभागज्ञः सर्वलोकप्रियंवदः॥
en: He is truthful and graceful, amasses wealth and thereby protects his subjects. He is cognisant of the divisions of time and country and dear to all.

sa: नीरूजो निव्रणांश्चैव संपनबलपौरुषान्। गोला)लांस्तथक्षांश्च द्रष्टुमिच्छामि मानद॥
en: O conferror of honour, I wish to see all these monkeys, Golarigālas and bears, pale and hurt, unheart and gifted with strength and prowess like before.

sa: अहं ज्ञात्वा नरव्याघ्र वर्तमानमदूरतः। ब्रह्मलोकं न गच्छामि त्वामदृष्ट्वा प्रियातिथिम्॥
en: O chief of men, knowing that you were near, I became anxious to go to the minor celestial regions and the supreme heaven (of Brahmā), after I had seen you, righteous and high-souled, who are my dear guest now.

sa: अपास्य मातृशुश्रूषामनर्थे सोऽवतिष्ठताम्। दीर्घबाहुमहावक्षा यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः॥
en: May he that had approved the exile of that long armed and broad breasted one, renouncing the ministration of his mother, turn his thoughts to evil!

sa: निवृत्तास्तु पुनः सर्वे दूषणाश्रयनिर्भयाः। राममेवाभ्यधावन्त सालतालशिलायुधाः॥
en: And rallied again (by Dāsana) and, their fear dispelled through their having founded refuge with him, they armed with sālas, tālas, and crags, darted against Rāma.

sa: हतपुत्रास्मि भगवंस्तव पुत्रैर्महाबलैः। शक्रहन्तारमिच्छामि पुत्रं दीर्घतपोर्जितम्॥
en: O adorable one, your high-souled sons have slain mine. I now wish for a son, who, obtained through long austerities, will be able to slay Sakra.

sa: राज्यप्रणाशः स्वजनैर्वियोगः पितुर्विनाशो जननीवियोगः। मापूरयन्ति प्रविचिन्तितानि॥
en: Coming within the compass remembrance, the loss of my kingdom, the death of my father, the separation of my mother and other kinsmen culminates my grief.

sa: ततस्तैश्चालिता नौका कर्णधारसमाहिता। शुभस्फ्यवेगाभिहता शीघ्रं सलिलमत्यगात्॥
en: Then the boat decked out by the heimsman, moved by them, and urged on by the pulls of the goodly roars, proceeded apace in the water.

sa: स विह्वलितसर्वाङ्गो गतबुद्धिर्विचेतनः। विषसादातुरो दीनो निःश्वस्याशीतमायतम्॥
en: He lost his sense and his whole frame was worked with grief. Being greatly anxious and breathless he sighed hot and fast and began to lament.

sa: ह्लादितस्तेन वाक्येन शुशुभे शुभदर्शनः। रामः संहृष्टवदनस्तानृषीनभ्यपूजयत्॥
en: Having paid homage to those saints, Rāma possessed of a gracious presence, hearing their words, was filled with joy, and looked lovely with his delightful countenance.

sa: ममोरुजवावेगेन भविष्यति समुत्थितः। समुत्थितमहाग्राहः समुद्रो वरुणालयः॥
en: Las by the force of my legs and thighs, that abode of Varuņa the sea, out which have sprung the ferocious aqua animals, overleaps its continents.

sa: कपिपत्न्या वचः श्रुत्वा कपयः कामरूपिणः। प्राप्तकालमविश्लिष्टमूचुर्वचनमङ्गनाम्॥
en: Hearing the words of that wife of the monkey, they, wearing shapes at will, addressed that damsel with words, worthy of being said on that occasion,

sa: एवमेकान्तसम्पृक्तौ ततस्तौ नरवानरौ। उभावन्योन्यसदृशं सुखं दुःखमभाषताम्॥
en: Thus fast bound in friendship, the man and the monkey conversed with each other about (topics) which each thought fit, connected with their joys and griefs.

sa: पम्पानदीनिवासानामनुमन्दाकिनीमपि। चित्रकूटालयानां च क्रियते कदनं महत्॥
en: And great is the worry that is experienced by the dwellers on the river Pampā and the Mandakini as well as those that reside in Citrakūta.

sa: काममेवंविधो लोकः कालेन विनियुज्यते। क्षमं चेद्भवता प्राप्तमुत्तरं साधु चिन्त्यताम्॥
en: Every one in time meets with death and hence there is nothing to be sorry for me. But do you think of a proper reply you shall give to the people (when asked about the cause of my destruction).

sa: एवं प्रचोदितो राजा कैकेय्या निर्विशङ्कया। नाशकत् पाशमुन्मोक्तुं बलिरिन्द्रकृतं यथा॥
en: Thus fearlessly urged by Kaikeyſ the king could not take off from himself the noose (of promise), even as Bali could not take off the noose that had been fixed upon him (by Upendra) at the instance of Indra.

sa: अत्यन्तसुखसंवृद्धः सुकुमारो हिमादितः। कथं त्वपररात्रेषु सरयूमवगाहते॥
en: Brought up in luxury, and exceedingly tender, how can he, afflicted with cold, perforim his ablutions in the Sarayū during the latter part of the night?

sa: अराजके धनं नास्ति नास्ति भार्याप्यराजके। इदमत्याहितं चान्यत् कुतः सत्यमराजके॥
en: A kingless kingdom possesses no wealth, and wives are hard to keep in such a place. This great fear attends a kingless country. And where is other morality (besides that detailed above) to be found at such a place?

sa: कालाग्निना यथा पूर्वं त्रैलोक्यं दह्यतेऽखिलम्॥ देवराज्यं चिकीर्षेत दीयतामस्य यन्मनः।
en: Therefore, O god, against the mighty Muni bending his mind upon destruction, and consuming the three entire worlds like to the fire raging at the universal dissolution, that exalted one of exceeding effulgence resembling a flame, should be pacified.

sa: तथापरेण कोटीनां सहस्रेण समन्वितः। पिता रुमायाः सम्प्राप्तः सुग्रीवश्वशुरो विभुः॥
en: Then Umā's father, that lord, the father-in-law of Sugrīva, arrived, accompanied with other thousands of kotis (of monkeys),... resembling the filaments of the lotus, of face like to the youthful sun, intelligent, the foremost of monkeys-supreme among them all.

sa: सासुराः सहगन्धर्वा सनागनरदेवताः। विदिताः सर्वलोकास्ते ससागरधराधराः॥
en: The entire worlds with Asuras, and Gandharvas, and Nāgas, and men, and gods, with oceans, and the earth and the regions beneath—are well known to you.

sa: सम्प्रत्यनेकाश्रयचित्रशोभा लक्ष्मीः शरत्कालगुणोपपन्ना। सूर्याग्रहस्तप्रतिबोधितेषु पद्माकरेष्वभ्यधिकं विभाति॥
en: Surely has the autumnal grace resorted to many things. And it has appeared more profusely in the lotuses blossomed by the first rays of the Sun.

sa: रुदिताश्रुपरिघुनं हाहाकृतमचेतनम्। प्रयाणे राघवस्यासीत् पुरं परमपीडितम्॥
en: And in consequence of Rāghava's departure, the entire city filled with despair, and uttering with their senses lost exclamations of "Oh" and "Alas," became exceedingly afflicted.

sa: पितुस्त्वमेव मे गत्वा शीघ्रमाचक्ष्व राघव॥ न त्वामनुदहेत् क्रुद्धो वनमग्निरिवैधितः।
en: Do you, O descendant of Raghu, yourself going to my father, speedily inform of him this that has occurred. But take care that like a fire waxing furious consuming a woods, he in his ire do not burn you.

sa: सुमन्त्र राजा रजनी रामहर्षसमुत्सुकुः। प्रजागरपरिश्रान्तो निद्रावशमुपागतः॥
en: Sumantra, being elated with joy on account of Răma's installation, the king has kept up the whole night, and being tired therefore, is overpowered with sleep.

sa: ततः कर्णोऽभ्ययादेनमस्यन्नस्यन्तमन्तिकात्॥ मातङ्ग इव मातङ्गं यूथर्षभमिवर्षभः।
en: Karna then advanced against the smiting Rakshasa smiting him in return from a near point, like an elephant rushing against another or a bull charging another.

sa: कषायं पाचयित्वाऽऽशु श्रेणिस्थानेषु च त्रिषु। प्रव्रजेच्च परं स्थानं पारिवाज्यमनुत्तमम्॥
en: Having conquered all shortcomings of the mind of heart by easy means in the practice of the first three modes of life, one should pass into the best and the highest of all the modes, viz., Sannyasa or Renunciation.

sa: त्वत्तो मया श्रुतं वीर श्रुतिभ्यश्च मया श्रुतम्। नोत्तरं हि मया वाच्यं मध्यमे प्रतिजानति।४।। व्याहृतं दुर्वचो घोरं हन्तास्मि लवणं मृधे। तस्यैवं मे दुरुक्तस्य दुर्गतिः पुरुषर्षभ॥
en: O hero, I have heard from you as well as from the Śruti (touching the morality concerned).* i.e. of being installed as a king during the life of my elder brother. When my second brother had already vowed (that he would slay Lavana), I ought not to have returned the answer I actually have. I saying, 'I will in battle slay the dreadful Lavaņa.' I have been guilty of an unrighteous speech. And it is for this transgression that, O powerful one, I shall have to undergo this improper process. *(i.e. of being installed as a king during the life of my elder brother.)

sa: हरिचन्दनसम्पृक्तमुदकं काञ्चनैर्घटैः। आनिन्युः स्नानशिक्षाज्ञा यथाकालं यथाविधि॥
en: Persons acquainted with the ceremonials connected with bath, according to the ordinance and in due time, in golden vessels brought water impregnated with Hair sandal powder.

sa: तमुदारं महासत्त्वमतिमानुषचेष्टितम्। समदुःखसुखं दृष्ट्वा विस्मित: पाकशासनः॥
en: The conqueror of Paka (Indra) was filled with wonder upon seeing that great and generous bird thus uninfluenced by misery or happiness and possessing extraordinary resolution.

sa: स रामो रथमास्थाय सम्प्रहृष्टसुहृज्जनः। पताकाध्वजसम्पन्नं महार्हागुरुधूपितम्॥ अपश्यनगरं श्रीमान् नानाजनसमन्वितम्। स गृहैरभ्रसंकाशैः पाण्डुरैरुपशोभितम्॥
en: Rāma, having his friends delighted, ascending the car, and viewing the city adorned with pennons and flags and incensed with Dhūpa and Agaru, entered the high way, crowded with people and containing houses coloured as the pale white clouds, and the place between the two rows whereof scented with Dhūpa and Agaru.

sa: सान्त्व्यमानो वीक्षमाणः पार्थेनाक्लिष्टकर्मणा। खिद्यत्येव महाबाहुरन्तर्दाहेन वीर्यवान्॥
en: Partha (Arjuna) of pure deeds pacified him with appealing looks, but the mighty armed and powerful (Bhima) began to burn in the fire of his anger.

sa: एतामक्षपयित्वा हि जायते नृपसत्तम। सा ह्यस्य प्रकृतिर्दृष्टा तत्क्षयान्मोक्ष उच्यते॥
en: Since those sixteen portions are the cause of the birth of creatures, creatures can never, O king, take birth without their help. They are called Nature. The destruction of Jiva's liability to be united with nature is called Liberation.

sa: यां चेमां मन्यसे धात्रीमेतद् बलमिति श्रुतम्। एतल्लक्ष्मणबाणानामीषत् कार्य विदारणम्॥
en: You considerest that this cave may serve for your protectress,* having heard of it (said by Tārā); but to rive the same is but light work for the shafts of Laksmana. *The word meaning cave is feminine in Sanskrit.

sa: यद्यप्यहं नरेन्द्रेण रहस्यं श्रावितं पुरा। तथाप्युदाहरिष्यामि दैवं हि दुरतिक्रमम्॥ येनेदमीदृशं प्राप्तं दुःखं शोकसमन्वितम्। न त्वया भरतस्याग्रे शत्रुघ्नस्यापि संनिधौ॥
en: Tough this mystery was communicated formerly by the king Dasaratha and though it is not proper to reveal it to any body, still I express it before you that you may not, on hearing it, be worked up with sorrow; for destiny is hard to be got over. And it is by the influence of that destiny that you have met with such a sorrow and grief. However, do you not reveal this secret to Satrughna and Bharata.

sa: भ्रामयित्वा शतगुणं गतसत्त्वमचेतनम्। प्रत्यपिंषन्महाबाहुर्मल्लं भुवि वृकोदरः॥
en: Then having whirled him round and round a hundred times, the mighty armed Vrikodara inade him utterly insensible and threw him down lifeless on the ground.

sa: तद्रामबाणाभिहतं पपात रक्ष:शिरः पर्वतसन्निकाशम्। बभञ्ज चर्यागृहगोपुराणि प्राकारमुच्वं तमपातयच्च ॥
en: And struck with Rāma's arrow, the head of the Rākşasa resembling a hill fell down to the earth; and (in its fall) crushed edifices on the highways and gateways; and elevated walls also it bore down to the ground.

sa: स तं दुर्गन्धमालक्ष्य देवदूतमुवाच ह। कियदध्वानमस्माभिर्गन्तव्यमिममीदृशम्॥
en: Seeing that inauspicious region full of every sort of fouiness, Yudhishthira asked the celestial messenger, saying, How far shall we go along a path like this?

sa: एतदिच्छाम्यहं श्रोतुमतिमानुषकर्मणाम्। तेषामाजननं सर्वं वैशम्पायन कीर्तय॥
en: I desire to hear all about those beings of extraordinary achievements, beginning from the moments of their births. O Vaishampayana, narrate to me all their achievements.

sa: सज्यं कृत्वा निमेषाच विव्याधार्जुनकेशवो। त्रिभिः शतैर्वासुदेवं सहस्रेण च पाण्डवम्॥
en: Having stretched his bow within so short a time as the twinkling of the eye, he (the son of . Drona) pierced both Arjuna and Keshava-Vashudeva with three hundred shafts and the son of Pandu with one thousand arrows.

sa: निजघ्नतुस्तावितरेतरं भृशम्। सकृत्प्रभिन्नाविव वासितान्तरे महागजौ मन्मथसक्तचेतसौ॥
en: As two lustful elephants fight for a sheelephant with fatty secretions streaming down their bodies, so did they strike each other with powerful and piercing shafts.

sa: सूतपुत्रस्त्वसम्भ्रान्तो रुद्रोपेन्द्रेन्द्रविक्रमः॥ घटोत्कचरथं तूर्णं छादयामास पत्रिभिः।
en: But the son of Suta Karna possessed prowess equal to that of Rudra or Upendra or Indra himself dauntlessly covered Ghatotkacha's chariot with his winged arrows.

sa: तौ सायकैरवच्छिन्नावदृश्येतां रणाजिरे। मेघजालसमाच्छन्नौ नभसीवेन्दुभास्करौ॥ 1४४॥
en: Those two (horses), shrouded with arrows on the field of battle, looked like the sun and the moon covered with masses of clouds in the firmament.

sa: ततस्त्वभूद् वै तलतालशब्दः सशङ्खभेरीपणवप्रणादः। प्रक्ष्वेडितज्यातलनिस्वनं तं वैकर्तनं पूजयतां कुरूणाम्॥
en: Then there arose the sound of the clapping of hands and that of conchs, trumpets and bugles while the Kurus spoke highly of Vikartana's son who filled the welkin with the sound of his bow-string striking against his gloves.

sa: तस्य तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा वालिसूनुरभाषत। अश्विपुत्रौ महावेगौ बलवन्तौ प्लवंगमौ॥
en: Hearing his words, Vali's son Angada spoke, saying, “These two monkeys, the sons of Aśvi, are very powerful and gifted with great velocity and are specially proud in consequence of the boon cornered on them by the Great Grandfather."

sa: ताश्चाप्युचाश्चमर्णा वारयित्वा खड्ड्रेनाजौ पातयित्वा नेरन्द्र। बाणैर्दिव्यैर्जामदग्न्यस्य संख्ये दिव्यानश्वानभ्यवर्ष ससूतान्॥
en: These too, O chief among men, I caused to fall to the ground with the heel of my sword and shield and then shot forth celestial arrows at the celestial horses of Rama and his charioteer in that battle.
